title: The One with the Split
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：basketball　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 basketball 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my brother nailed ① a basketball hoop to the back of the shed and missed it for eleven years, and my father said the missing was the whole of the practice. The ② basketball, meaning the ball and not the game, was bought second-hand and was never round again; a basketball, he said, is the only piece of equipment that is improved by being thrown at a wall.

Every ③ basketball in that street belonged to whoever had it, and the ④ basketball with the split, meaning the one that bounced wrong and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever learned to control. A basketball, my grandmother said, is nine parts air and one part somebody willing to run; my brother said the running is the part that counts.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ basketball was the whole of a winter, meaning the game and not the ball. The ⑥ basketball, meaning the hours in the yard and not any of that, is the only sport that can be played alone and argued about for years; a basketball, she said, is either something you throw or the only game where losing to yourself is normal. He said the losing was the practice.

By 1975 the ⑦ basketball had become a photograph in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about who had been in the yard. The ⑧ basketball of the whole thing, my brother wrote in March, was eleven years of missing and one good afternoon; a basketball, he said, is either the ball with the split or the reason you learned to run. She said the running was the part nobody photographed.

The ⑨ basketball I remember is the one with the split, which was thrown away in 1978 and never replaced. A ⑩ basketball, my mother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being ruined; every basketball, she said, is a winter that has agreed to look like a ball. He said the winter was the real part.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 篮球（指那个球，与比赛相对）
C. 固定搭配：a basketball hoop 篮球筐／篮圈
D. n. 篮球（指那条街上每一个）
E. n. 篮球（指裂了的那一个）
F. n. 篮球运动（指那个冬天打球这件事）
G. n. 篮球运动（抽象：在院子里耗掉的那些小时）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The basketball, meaning the ball and not the game
basketball was the whole of a winter
The basketball, meaning the hours in the yard
the basketball had become a photograph in a paper
The basketball of the whole thing
A basketball, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: a basketball hoop 意为“篮球筐、篮圈”，1962 年哥哥把一只篮球筐钉在了棚屋后墙上。
basketball 意为“篮球”，指那个球而不是比赛，它是二手买的，从此再没圆过。
basketball 指那条街上每一个篮球，那条街上每一个都属于拿着它的那个人。
basketball 指裂了的那一个（弹得不准的那一个），是唯一有人学会控制的。
basketball 意为“篮球运动”，指那个冬天打球这件事，母亲说它就是整个冬天。
basketball 为抽象用法，指在院子里耗掉的那些小时，是唯一能一个人打、却能吵上好几年的运动。
basketball 意为“篮球”，到 1975 年这个 basketball 成了报纸上的一张照片。
basketball 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，哥哥三月写道，整件事权衡下来是十一年的投失和一个像样的下午。
basketball 意为“篮球”，我记得的是裂了的那一个，1978 年被扔掉，再没补上。
basketball 为抽象总称，母亲说篮球是唯一会因为被弄坏而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1962 年哥哥把一只篮球筐钉在棚屋后墙上，然后投丢了十一年，父亲说投丢就是训练的全部。（a basketball hoop）
那个篮球，指的是那个球而不是比赛，是二手买的，从此再没圆过。（basketball）
那条街上每一个篮球都属于拿着它的那个人。（basketball）
裂了那个篮球，指的是弹得不准的那一个，是唯一有人学会控制的。（basketball）
母亲说篮球就是整个冬天，指的是打球这件事而不是那个球。（basketball）
1980 年母亲说，篮球是唯一会因为被弄坏而变好的东西。（basketball）
answers: In 1962 my brother nailed a basketball hoop to the back of the shed and missed it for eleven years, and my father said the missing was the whole of the practice.
The basketball, meaning the ball and not the game, was bought second-hand and was never round again.
Every basketball in that street belonged to whoever had it.
The basketball with the split, meaning the one that bounced wrong and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever learned to control.
My mother said basketball was the whole of a winter, meaning the game and not the ball.
A basketball, my mother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being ruined.
